## Review Path

- [ ] I kept the change scoped to one behavior, doc area, or workflow.
- [ ] I updated docs or README links when public behavior changed.
- [ ] I included ranking, corpus, embedding, or cluster identifiers when relevant.
- [ ] I avoided committing secrets, private data, raw provider payloads, or database dumps.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate:web`
- [ ] `npm run validate:py`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] Docs/template-only change; checked Markdown/YAML formatting instead.
